name: Moonshiner
look: an upright raccoon bandit in a wide-brimmed hat and trench coat lined with ceramic jugs, with a ringed tail
entry: Moonshiner builds hidden stills deep in mountain forests, using reflective mirrors to hide its campfire smoke from patrolling Ranger Pokémon.
how: Evolve Bootlegger at level 34 at night. It learns Knock Off when it evolves.
Wild: rare, at night, in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
